create_budget: create a budget via POST to the /budget/new endpoint with budget_id, duration, and max_budget
delete_budget: delete a budget by its ID via POST to the /budget/delete endpoint
test_create_budget_with_duration: test that a newly created budget has a budget_reset_at matching the next standardized reset time
parse_budget_api_datetime: parse an ISO timestamp string from the budget proxy API into a timezone-aware datetime object
review_budget_setup_fixture: review the pytest async fixture that creates a budget for testing and cleans it up afterward
